behaviors: Read all original PTY/managed assertions. The new matrix exercises 24 resolved provider requests across both engine routes with absent/true/false/null legacy stamps. Every stamp yields the identical provider request; it neither confers nor restricts ambient profile/permission authority.

Selected trusted profile preserves CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, all local extra arguments, selected MCP IDs and the opus[1m]/opus/1000000 model tuple on both routes. Explicit skipPermissions and bypassPermissions remain provider-native requests with the original distinction between resolved skip/fullAccess and requested permission mode; PTY flags and managed yolo/permission_mode are checked.

Existing real MCP parity test independently checks that legacy metadata survives facade forwarding without inventing a new gate; actual spawn-plan tests cover explicit-false precedence, manager preferences and malformed wire types.
intentionalChanges: Obsolete grant stamps remain inert compatibility data; no per-session grant checks or profile argument filtering are reinstated. Selected profiles are trusted local configuration, separately scrubbed on remote profile mutation.
